certification.reason: The source set is not a complete raw-turn corpus. The fixed-three Asset Bank row proved that assistant-generated synthesis can enter search/context summaries without user approval.

retrieval.method: Date-window retrieval from project conversation search, retained project context, and available project snippets.
retrieval.reason: The supplied raw ChatGPT export ends on 2026-07-09. This supplement is an audit-lead inventory only and cannot prove that every July 10-30 turn was retrieved or interpreted correctly.

authority_policy.rule: Only verbatim-supported explicit user approval, correction, or rejection may establish or supersede a current decision.
authority_policy.provisional_rule: A project-conversation-search row is a lead requiring raw verification, regardless of the status printed in its index row.
authority_policy.do_not_infer: Silence, implementation existence, retained memory, or an assistant summary without exact user evidence does not create a decision.
